author: Jsp9911
quote: The game is a buggy mess with constant and severe frame drops below 30 fps. The critic scores were clearly paid for and the most anyone can say about the game is it looks great when you are standing still. If I wanted to see perfect reflections while driving at night or a nice view of a city or the water I’d do it in real life! Where is the innovation? 13 years to get the sims with the driving feeling like ass, to go backwards from 5 forcing you into doing realistic chores. Again, I do that in real life this isn’t what I play games for! The guns feel like ****, the driving feels like **** and the story ****. An increase in price over the standard game pricing plus the fact once you start downloading the game you are locked from a refund, boy I wonder why they went full digital, I wonder why user reviews were delayed by review sites, I wonder why they didn’t show any of the first 7 hours of the game in promotional material. This is a cash grab and yea they made their money, they were always going to because of the hype after 5 but this studio is dead to me at this point. I won’t be spending another dime on their games just to be lied to. The cope on the internet with people trying to defend this is insane and only reinforces the idea that the real world just may be a simulation with the majority of people being NPC’s, I’m only half joking here. Obviously, in real life treat your loved ones like they matter, but them things, fix up your house, do your chores, but that isn’t what GTA has been and not what was sold to us as gamers.
